responsibility: Provides the AVR machine-description support for 64-bit integer and 64-bit fixed-point modes using a specialized accumulator-based RTL model. Because generic lowering produces poor code for wide operations on this 8-bit target, this file defines expanders, splits, and insn patterns for arithmetic, comparisons, shifts, branches, and widening multiplies in `DI`, `DQ`, `DA`, and `TA` families, steering many operations into fixed hard-register calling conventions and libgcc helper calls while avoiding a general `movdi` implementation and constraining reload behavior.
